title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SingleScheduledAction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SingleScheduledAction. [COSEM] This class allows modelling the execution of periodic actions within a meter; such actions are not necessarily linked to tariffication.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SingleScheduledAction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

executesScript.description: Relationship. [COSEM] Defines the script to be executed.

hasExecutionTime.description: Property. [COSEM] Specifies the time and the date when the script is executed.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code uniquely identifying this single-scheduled-action COSEM object.
